mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parking_log (vehicle_num, entry_time) VALUES (#{vehicleNum}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM parking_log WHERE vehicle_num = #{vehicleNum} AND exit_time IS NULL ORDER BY entry_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT parking_log_id AS parkingLogId, vehicle_num AS vehicleNum, entry_time AS entryTime, exit_time AS exitTime, is_member AS isMember, payment_status AS paymentStatus FROM parking_log WHERE parking_log_id = #{parkingLogId}
SELECT m.mem_id FROM mem m JOIN member_vehicle mv ON m.mem_id = mv.mem_id WHERE mv.vehicle_num = #{vehicleNum} LIMIT 1
